Copilot support targets GitHub.com cloud-agent tasks and pull-request code review;
a local Mac client is not required.

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the authoritative repository development
contract, before editing. Client capabilities vary: consult the
[supported surface matrix](../docs/supported-agents.md) and use the shared commands
and required GitHub checks specified there. This adapter adds no independent policy.
